ranking: Local rubric: pushes + 3 * box switches + 12 * goal withdrawals + 5 * boxes. Sort all 140 levels by this score, then stable ID; group into seven chapters of 20. Raw scores are not Cosmos author scores; the seven labels and ranges are adopted as a local classification. No optimality claim for new solution paths.
exclusionReason: Original source marks these as derived from SokHard; omitted to keep author provenance unambiguous.
